lines.zh: 厚掌踩过落叶，整片林子都听得见。
lines.en: Each heavy paw crunches leaves loud enough for the whole forest.

lines.zh: 顺着蜂蜜味走，蜂巢就在前头。
lines.en: Follow the honey smell; the hive is just ahead.

lines.zh: 针叶林这条兽径我走了许多年。
lines.en: I have worn this taiga trail for many seasons.

lines.zh: 一前一后，崽子跟在我脚印里。
lines.en: Cubs step in my prints, one behind the other.

lines.zh: 桦木林的白皮一闪一闪，我记得路。
lines.en: Those white birch trunks flash, and I know the way.

lines.zh: 溪水在下个坡，鲑鱼正肥。
lines.en: The stream lies past the next slope, and the salmon are fat.

lines.zh: 肩膀撞开灌木，不必绕路。
lines.en: My shoulder shoves the brush aside; I do not detour.

lines.zh: 雪化之后，熊道比人的路更直。
lines.en: After the snow melts, the bear trail runs straighter than yours.

lines.zh: 爪子收着走，省得刨坏树根。
lines.en: I keep my claws sheathed so the roots stay whole.

lines.zh: 这一带浆果熟了，我巡一圈。
lines.en: The berries here have ripened; I walk my round.

lines.zh: 闻得出昨天有谁从这儿过去。
lines.en: My nose tells me who passed here yesterday.

lines.zh: 皮毛底下全是力气，走慢点也无妨。
lines.en: There is strength under this fur; walking slow costs nothing.

lines.zh: 顺着风走，蜜味才不会被吹散。
lines.en: I walk downwind so the honey scent does not scatter.

lines.zh: 林子深处有我的旧窝，快到了。
lines.en: My old den waits deeper in the woods, nearly there.

lines.zh: 我沿着河岸走，掌印留在湿泥上。
lines.en: I walk the riverbank, leaving prints in wet mud.

lines.zh: 蜂蜜的味道从树洞里透出来。
lines.en: The smell of honey seeps from a hollow trunk.
I stand up to reach the high branch.

lines.zh: 幼崽叫了一声，我回头等它。
lines.en: My cub calls once, so I stop and wait.

lines.zh: 浆果丛被踩倒了，谁干的？
lines.en: The berry bushes are trampled. Who did it?
Along the treeline, one more lap.

lines.zh: 雨水把蜂巢的味道冲淡了。
lines.en: Rain has washed the beehive scent thin.

lines.zh: 蜂蜜的味道，隔着松树都闻得到。
lines.en: I smell honey through the pines.

lines.zh: 林子里走一遭，浆果全没了。
lines.en: One walk through the forest clears the berries.
The pine needles are soft; my steps make no sound.
One swipe of my paw bends a tree trunk.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草会直起来。
lines.en: The grass straightens after I pass.
The stream sounds ahead. I walk slow.
Through the birch wood, I walk slow.

lines.zh: 别催，我正穿过这片桦木林。
lines.en: Don't rush me, I am crossing the birches.
As far as the river bend, and that's a day.
In the snow, my prints sink deepest.

lines.zh: 桦木林的浆果丛，我年年都来。
lines.en: These birch berry bushes, I visit every year.

lines.zh: 林子里的浆果，我还没吃完。
lines.en: I have not finished the berries in this wood.

lines.zh: 这块石头，去年也在这儿。
lines.en: This boulder was here last year too.
Sitting still, I fill half of this narrow trail.

lines.zh: 舔一舔爪子，蜂蜜还粘着。
lines.en: I lick my paw; honey still clings to it.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚出一声闷响，不是威胁。
lines.en: A low rumble rolls in my throat; it is no threat.
Bark against my back scratches the itch perfectly.
A quick count: both cubs are right here.

lines.zh: 蜂在耳朵边转，我不在乎。
lines.en: Bees circle my ear, and I do not care.

lines.zh: 喘气把地上的雪吹出两个洞。
lines.en: My breath melts two small holes in the snow.

lines.zh: 鲑鱼的味道从水里飘过来。
lines.en: The smell of salmon drifts up from the water.

lines.zh: 这块石头晒得暖，先趴一会儿。
lines.en: This stone is warm; I will lie here a while.

lines.zh: 蜂巢就挂在那边，我记住了。
lines.en: That hive hangs over there, and I have noted it.
My eyes half close, but my ears stay up.
My winter coat has not shed; it feels stuffy.

lines.zh: 崽子打闹，我只抬了下眼皮。
lines.en: The cubs wrestle; I barely lift an eyelid.

lines.zh: 爪子敲地，数着林子里的动静。
lines.en: My claws tap the ground, counting every sound.

lines.zh: 蜂蜜的味道，还在鼻子里。
lines.en: The smell of honey is still in my nose.
I lean on the birch and rest a while.
The shade moved a foot; I didn't.
I'm listening to the hive.

lines.zh: 蜂蜜的味道还在鼻子里。
lines.en: The smell of honey is still in my nose.

lines.zh: 风穿过松林，像有人在叫。
lines.en: Wind through the pines sounds like a call.
My paws in the fallen leaves, I stare.
Today suits doing nothing.
Ants crawl over my paw. Quiet.

lines.zh: 我挠了挠树皮，再坐会儿。
lines.en: I scratch the bark and sit a while longer.

lines.zh: 树冠缝里的天，蓝得发闷。
lines.en: Through the canopy the sky is a dull blue.

lines.zh: 我这身板，站着就占地方。
lines.en: This bulk of mine takes up space just standing.

lines.zh: 在想哪棵树的蜂蜜最甜。
lines.en: Thinking which tree has the sweetest honey.

lines.zh: 是松鼠，从树干上溜下去。
lines.en: A squirrel slipped down the trunk.

lines.zh: 蜂蜜的蜂巢，我一爪撕开。
lines.en: One swipe opens the honeycomb.
Summer is short. I need to fatten up.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，这是我的林子。
lines.en: You stand too close; this is my forest.
First I check whether you carry honey.

lines.zh: 你的气味我不认得，别乱动。
lines.en: Your scent is new to me; do not move suddenly.

lines.zh: 背上那包东西，闻起来能吃。
lines.en: That pack on your back smells edible.
I guard my cubs, so keep your hands down.

lines.zh: 退到溪那边去，我懒得挪步。
lines.en: Go past the creek; I cannot be bothered to move.

lines.zh: 那块木头挡不住我的爪子。
lines.en: That stick will not stop my claws.

lines.zh: 站着别蹲，蹲下我会误会。
lines.en: Stand, do not crouch; crouching looks like a challenge.
You smell faintly of beeswax to me.

lines.zh: 镜片后面的眼睛在打量我。
lines.en: Those eyes behind glass are sizing me up.

lines.zh: 我在估你的斤两，别得意。
lines.en: I am weighing your worth; do not flatter yourself.

lines.zh: 溪边归我，路可以借你走。
lines.en: The creek is mine; you may borrow the path.

lines.zh: 崽子在后面，我看着你就够。
lines.en: The cubs are behind me; watching you is enough.

lines.zh: 鼻孔一鼓，就知道你在发抖。
lines.en: One snort and I know you are shivering.
There's honey in that basket of yours.

lines.zh: 抓完鲑鱼，我爪子上全是腥味。
lines.en: After salmon, my paws reek of fish.

lines.zh: 把棍子放下，我们好好看。
lines.en: Put the stick down and we'll look at each other.

lines.zh: 幼崽在我身后，别再靠近。
lines.en: My cubs are behind me. Come no closer.
Don't touch my horns.
I'm watching you. Don't move.

lines.zh: 你身上有烟火和面粉味。
lines.en: You smell of smoke and flour.
You smell like snacks.

lines.zh: 我嘴边的浆果汁还没擦。
lines.en: I still have berry juice on my muzzle.
I walk this forest every day.

lines.zh: 这片林子，你可以坐会儿。
lines.en: This forest has room for you to sit.

lines.zh: 上次你落脚很轻，这次重。
lines.en: Your steps were light last time, heavy now.
That one only makes me turn my head.
My fur is thick; your effort is wasted.
Bee stings do not scare me, let alone this.
Grrr, you had better run right now.
It stings, but my temper stings worse.
You have frightened my cubs.
One more hit and I stop being gentle.

lines.zh: 爪子在地上刨出三道沟。
lines.en: My claws carve three grooves in the dirt.
A night's sleep will mend this scratch.
You landed that blow, yet you did not retreat.

lines.zh: 鼻头挨了一下，血滴在落叶上。
lines.en: A hit on my snout; blood drips on the leaves.
I'll carve this one into my claws.

lines.zh: 五十五点命，也扛不住连着打。
lines.en: Fifty-five points can't take hit after hit.
I need somewhere to hide.
My paw missed. Don't celebrate.
Fifty-five hit points still hold.
My roar comes out all shaky.

lines.zh: 别打背，我的旧伤在那里。
lines.en: Not the back; my old wound is there.

lines.zh: 我弓起背，喉咙里发闷响。
lines.en: I arch my back, a low rumble in my throat.
Who dares swat me in these woods?
Honeycomb, toss it here, and toss it slowly.
Stop shaking that jar; the honey will spill.
Honey first, fish after; that order I accept.

lines.zh: 鲑鱼的银鳞在闪，我看得清。
lines.en: That salmon's silver scales flash, and I see them.
One more step with that hand and I will bite.

lines.zh: 蜂巢砸开一半给我，也行。
lines.en: Crack the hive open and leave me half.

lines.zh: 甜味盖过你的味道，好办。
lines.en: The sweetness covers your scent; that helps.
Hold it steady; do not let honey reach the dirt.
I want the fish still flopping.
One lick, and I will count you harmless.

lines.zh: 蜂蜜抹在木头上，我照样吃。
lines.en: Smear the honey on wood; I will eat it anyway.
Take two steps back and clear the wind.

lines.zh: 这东西甜得像我去年挖的巢。
lines.en: This is as sweet as the hive I dug out last year.

lines.zh: 吃完这条鱼，我或许跟你走。
lines.en: Finish this fish, and I might walk with you.
One open honey jar and I'm here.
The smell of honey gets in my nose.

lines.zh: 你手里的浆果，红得正好。
lines.en: The berries in your hand are just ripe.
I'll follow you; don't run too fast.
Set the jar down; I'll lick it myself.

lines.zh: 蜂蜜的味道，是从你身上来的。
lines.en: The honey smell comes from you.
This smells stronger than the hive itself.
One more spoon of honey and I'll follow.
So sweet my paws go weak.
Closer. One sniff and I'll go.

lines.zh: 我的食槽边，谁都不许站。
lines.en: Nobody stands by my feeding trough.

lines.zh: 你口袋里还有，我都闻到了。
lines.en: There's more in your pocket. I smell it.
Don't shake the jar; it will spill.
I still remember that last jar.
Those berries smell sweet.
That salmon is still jumping!

lines.zh: 撞一下算什么，我又没用力。
lines.en: A bump means nothing; I barely leaned.

lines.zh: 你挡在我和蜂巢中间了。
lines.en: You are standing between me and that hive.
This shoulder is harder than you assume.
Move aside; these next steps will not stop.

lines.zh: 踩到你脚了？那你自己挪开。
lines.en: Did I step on your foot? Then move it.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，热气都喷你脸上了。
lines.en: Do not press close; my breath is on your face.

lines.zh: 这身板拐弯要花点时间。
lines.en: This body needs time to turn around.
A cub is by my paws, so I move slowly.
Push back if you like; I would watch that.

lines.zh: 擦过就算了，别再顶过来。
lines.en: A brush is fine; do not shove again.
That bump filled my eyes with stars.
This forest path won't fit us both.

lines.zh: 我的肩撞上去，反倒自己麻了。
lines.en: My shoulder hit it, and I went numb instead.
Don't crowd; this bulk won't stop.

lines.zh: 你把我背上的毛蹭乱了。
lines.en: You've mussed the fur on my back.
Lucky for you, I just ate.
You can't budge this bulk.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌下去，蜂蜜都洒了。
lines.en: One swipe and the honey spills.
One bump from me and the trees shake.
My paw nearly came down on you.

lines.zh: 春天到了，林子里都是气味。
lines.en: Spring is here, and the woods brim with scent.
I rake the bark to leave my mark.
Keep close, and do not startle anyone.
This berry patch belongs to the two of us.

lines.zh: 嗓门压低了，可还是闷响。
lines.en: I lower my growl, yet it still rumbles.
That flat spot by the creek suits us best.

lines.zh: 我护着你，谁来都挡回去。
lines.en: I stand before you and turn any comer back.

lines.zh: 明年这时候，会有小脚印。
lines.en: By this time next year, there will be small prints.

lines.zh: 别蹭那么用力，毛都乱了。
lines.en: Do not rub so hard; my fur is a mess.

lines.zh: 秋天之前，我们得吃胖些。
lines.en: Before autumn, we both must eat our fill.

lines.zh: 你身上有松脂和太阳味。
lines.en: You smell of pine resin and sun.
Don't hide — look up at me once.

lines.zh: 这片浆果坡，够我们过冬。
lines.en: This berry slope will see us through winter.

lines.zh: 我这身五十五点血，还算温柔。
lines.en: Fifty-five health, and still gentle.
Do not go; stay with me a little longer.

lines.zh: 溪边的洞穴，我铺了干草。
lines.en: I lined the den by the stream with dry grass.

lines.zh: 林子里有个伴，冬天好过。
lines.en: A mate in the woods makes winter easier.
Our cubs will learn to raid hives.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我闻到了蜂蜜。
lines.en: In the taiga, I smell honey.
Slow down. No rush.
I will carry this honeycomb off in my teeth.
Fish dropped on the ground belong to me.
These berries are dusty, and I eat them anyway.

lines.zh: 骨头叼回去，给崽子磨牙。
lines.en: I haul this bone back for the cubs to gnaw.
I pick things up with my mouth; my claws are blunt.

lines.zh: 这团毛是换下来的，不是伤。
lines.en: This tuft is shed fur, not a wound.
I can gnaw wood too; I will keep this.
Whose hive fragment is this? I will take it.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，捡了不算偷。
lines.en: Taking what falls is not stealing, by my rules.
I hold it steady so no honey drips behind me.

lines.zh: 我捡东西，别以为我没看见你。
lines.en: I am picking this up, and I saw you watching.
Wait. I can pick things up?

lines.zh: 爪子一扒，树皮底下有虫。
lines.en: One claw scrape and there are grubs under the bark.
Smells sweet, but it's wood.
Found it. Mine.

lines.zh: 爪子里这个，还能再叼一个。
lines.en: One in my paw, room for one more.
Just passing by. Convenient.
Tucked under my neck, warm.

lines.zh: 这蜂巢我掏过好几回了。
lines.en: I've raided this hive more than once.
I smelled this honey first.

lines.zh: 你进了我的距离，那就别怪我。
lines.en: You entered my range; do not blame me.
That honey smell is in your hands.
Cubs, go back; I will handle this.

lines.zh: 先低头，再站起来，你也该走了。
lines.en: I lower my head, then rise; you should leave.

lines.zh: 这片针叶林，容不下第二头熊。
lines.en: These spruce woods hold no second bear.
You are not retreating fast, so I close in.

lines.zh: 爪子抓地，是在给你数秒。
lines.en: My claws rake dirt, counting down for you.
Keep your hands away from my cubs.
My nose wrinkles; the meaning is clear.

lines.zh: 追不追，看你还站不站着。
lines.en: Whether I chase depends on whether you stay.
Don't make me charge.

lines.zh: 五十五点血的熊，站起来更高。
lines.en: A fifty-five-point bear stands even taller.
On my hind legs I top you by two heads.

lines.zh: 我的爪子比你的手臂还长。
lines.en: My claws are longer than your arm.
Every bear in this wood answers my roar.
Today's meal needs blood in it.
Turning your back is a poor idea.

lines.zh: 你退到树后，我也看得见。
lines.en: Hide behind that tree; I still see you.
My paw is up. Run.
Honey thief, stand still.

lines.zh: 四条腿追两条，你输定了。
lines.en: Four legs chase two, and you have already lost.
Turning will not help; I take the short way.

lines.zh: 喘气越来越重，那是好事。
lines.en: My breathing grows heavy, and that is a good sign.
Do not climb; I will wait at the bottom.

lines.zh: 你把蜂蜜丢下了，太晚了。
lines.en: You dropped the honey, but it is too late.
Your prints sit in the mud; they hide nothing.
One more circle and my teeth will reach.
The branch you snapped points me your way.

lines.zh: 我留着劲，等最后那几步。
lines.en: I save my strength for the final few strides.

lines.zh: 跑进溪里？水也拦不住我。
lines.en: Run into the creek? The water will not stop me.
I can cross this stream in one step.
I just want an explanation.
I'm behind you. Still here.
Go around the tree; I'll be waiting.
Don't make me run this fast.
I am big, and my turns are slow.

lines.zh: 每棵树的味道，我都认得。
lines.en: I know the scent of every tree here.
Hear my hooves?
Every hive in this forest is mine.
The paw is raised — better run.
One swipe is all it takes.
My claws arrive first, my teeth second.
This one is for the hive you broke.

lines.zh: 你撞在我胸口，像撞树干。
lines.en: You hit my chest like hitting a tree trunk.
My hide is thick; your blade parts only fur.
This jaw is locked; you will not pull free.
You fall back three steps; I take two.
One roar and the whole forest goes quiet.

lines.zh: 这一爪是提醒，下一爪不是。
lines.en: This paw is a warning; the next is not.
The smell of blood only sharpens me.

lines.zh: 熊掌落下去，土都翻起来。
lines.en: My paw comes down and the soil turns.

lines.zh: 五十多点血，够你打一阵。
lines.en: Over fifty health — that's a long fight.
One shove of my shoulder sends you flying.
Back off and I'll stop.

lines.zh: 森林里我站起来比树高。
lines.en: In the forest I stand taller than the trees.

lines.zh: 爪子擦过，你的衣服裂了。
lines.en: My claws pass and your coat splits.

lines.zh: 我的爪子比你的斧头钝不了。
lines.en: My claws are as blunt as your axe.
Consider that a warning.
You hit my nose, and it stings.

lines.zh: 小崽在树后看着，别怪重。
lines.en: My cubs are watching. Don't blame me for the weight.

lines.zh: 雪刚化，我从窝里出来了。
lines.en: The snow just melted, and I leave my den.
This spruce forest is mine this year.
Two small ones trail behind me.

lines.zh: 蜂巢的味道，从那边飘来。
lines.en: The smell of a hive drifts from over there.

lines.zh: 先绕一圈，看看谁住这儿。
lines.en: First a slow circuit, to see who lives here.

lines.zh: 树皮上还留着去年的抓痕。
lines.en: Last year's claw marks still score the bark.
The creek runs low, so the fish should be easy.
Wind from the north still carries snow.
A few steps to test this new coat.
The woods are quiet, a fine place to rest.

lines.zh: 桦木林那边，我记得有蜜。
lines.en: I recall honey in the birch grove over there.

lines.zh: 脚下这层落叶，是去年的。
lines.en: The leaf litter under me is last year's.
Is this meadow?
Standing, I am taller than a stump.

lines.zh: 我从冬眠的土里爬出来。
lines.en: I've just dug out of my winter den.
Is there grass here?
Just woke up. World's bright.
Starting today, I walk slow.

lines.zh: 我还记得一点点，森林的味道。
lines.en: I still remember a little: the smell of the forest.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，先找蜂蜜的味道。
lines.en: I open my eyes and look for honey first.
The snow's melting. I should head down.
I didn't open my eyes all winter.

lines.zh: 毛烧焦的味道，我记住了。
lines.en: I will remember the smell of singed fur.
My fur is on fire! Who did that?

lines.zh: 从这么高摔下来，骨头还在。
lines.en: Falling from that height, and my bones hold.

lines.zh: 这一摔，我肩上的脂肪救了命。
lines.en: That fall, and the fat on my shoulders saved me.
Water fills my nose, and I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 谁在这林子里挖的深沟？
lines.en: Who dug this deep ditch in the forest?
My ears ring, and I cannot stand straight.
I got flipped. Still alive.
The arrow sticks in my fur like a thorn.

lines.zh: 箭扎进厚毛里，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow is stuck in my thick fur.
That strange taste is worse than bee venom.
This light sets my wound burning.
My belly is empty and no honey anywhere.

lines.zh: 冬天林子里的果子，都冻硬了。
lines.en: Winter berries in this forest are all frozen hard.
The lightning struck, and all my fur stands.
I'm numb all over. Can't move.
There is no soil here, and no honey.

lines.zh: 爪子抓空，什么都抓不住。
lines.en: My paws claw at nothing at all.
